subject: RDMA: Support user keepalive command (#916)
reason: The change is confined to src/rdma.c: a per-connection keepalive timer, zero-initialized ValkeyRdmaCmd structs, and event-loop plumbing in the RDMA accept/disconnect path. That code runs only when a client connects over the RDMA transport, which requires a build with BUILD_RDMA and an RDMA device (soft-RoCE setup needs root, which these runs do not have). No installed experiment or component speaks RDMA — they all connect over TCP — so no composable experiment or scenario can reach the changed code paths.
